title: Separate an approximation comparator from acquired source coefficients
statement: The delivered acquisition proof compares the acquired interpolant with an unknown Taylor or spectral polynomial that is never supplied to the learner. The signed Taylor remainder is delta G^2 q^k/(1+q),q=delta*kappa; its nondecay at q>=1 motivates a different approximation comparator, not free coefficient access.

Acquired offset r0 for converting native R=r0+J to J
provides: A source-bound route for evaluating approximation and noise debits separately
assumptions: Any spectral comparator rate retains its declared q regime
No latent poles, low rank or individual coupling are acquired by the comparator
costs: M=binom(n+k,k) scalar source readings at support-at-most-k lattice commands; calibration, setting/clearing, resets and complete physical work remain

contract.obstruction: An existence proof for a good polynomial does not acquire its coefficients.

evidence.quote: # Finite sparse acquisition of an approximate complete intervention law
evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: The binomial node count remains; sparse command support does not make acquisition dimension-free. Fit quality does not prove source physics, stability, control/reset or calibration warrants. Shared calibration error is correlated and is not automatically multiplied by C_k. Equal-information conventional methods can use the same acquisition; no physical device, photon lower bound or practical advantage follows. Historical N1089 code/run remains unacquired; these fresh implementations are not its replay. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Delivered completed scoped internal challenge of the positive Bernstein route, interpolation/noise/Taylor boundaries and objective conversion; no independent whole-program or unspecified-physics acceptance. Source-reported five synthetic acquisitions and30tasks are preserved without replay.
